name: sfx_ui_tap
description: Soft glass tick for ordinary buttons

name: sfx_ui_confirm
description: A latch catching: a light brass touch, then the bolt seats

name: sfx_ui_back
description: Gentle downward tick

name: sfx_ui_panel_open
description: Airy page/panel sweep

name: sfx_ui_panel_close
description: Softer reverse sweep

name: sfx_ui_denied
description: A locked latch tried: the bolt knocks its keeper twice, muffled, and does not give

name: sfx_ui_select
description: Party/item selection tick

name: sfx_reward_collect
description: Enhance taken in: a warm breath at the heart, the specimen's grains lifting off it like heat and settling back

name: sfx_currency_gain
description: Coins in: a small handful dropped on a pile, the last one rocking to rest

name: sfx_purchase_success
description: Coins out: two set down on a wooden counter, and a brass purse clasp snapped shut

name: sfx_upgrade_complete
description: Set in place, and lit: a stone grinds into its socket, seats, and a warm flame catches in it

name: sfx_achievement_unlock
description: Sealed: parchment pressed flat, a brass seal into warm wax on a wooden desk, and lifted; gone before the reward flight lands

name: sfx_cosmic_portal_open
description: Space drawn in on itself -- air, a deep strain, grains spiralling -- and giving at 0.95 s into the dark

name: sfx_cosmic_orb_pickup
description: Star dust taken: a pinch of gold leaf shaken over a breath, a little dark glass under it

name: sfx_cosmic_orb_deposit
description: The hold poured out into the home planet, and the planet taking the weight: a deep soft body

name: sfx_cosmic_anomaly_burst
description: Flung across space by a warp anomaly: a leaned-in rush, space tearing, streaming away through the tunnel

name: sfx_cosmic_starforge_activate
description: A planet gate unsealed: the offering poured in, an ancient stone mechanism turning and seating, the deep breathing out

name: sfx_cosmic_dash
description: The booster catching: a gas chuff leaning in, flame tearing up, air torn past the hull

name: sfx_cosmic_planet_enter
description: Down through the glyph portal: script written out of the void, a tunnel rushing faster ring by ring, the deep of the dungeon

name: sfx_cosmic_cache_open
description: An elemental cache unsealed over its 3 s ritual: element streaming in, glass halves grinding apart, shards whirling loose, the give

name: sfx_cosmic_discovery
description: Something new in the dark: the air opening out, far glints coming into focus, a low glass under it

name: sfx_cosmic_scan
description: A scanner locking on: a glass pivot spinning up and settling, a fan of motes sweeping left to right

name: sfx_combat_projectile
description: A compressed puff through a short barrel and a catch clicking: the ship's gun

name: sfx_combat_hit_light
description: A small dense knock on an obsidian body, a flake or two off it

name: sfx_combat_hit_heavy
description: A heavy blow on obsidian: a low dense body, a crunch, debris thrown wide

name: sfx_combat_player_hurt
description: A blow on the hull heard from inside: a muffled plate and a rattle

name: sfx_combat_enemy_defeat
description: An obsidian body cracks, breaks and throws its shards outward

name: sfx_combat_shield_hit
description: A knock on the orb's thick glass bubble and the air it turns aside

name: sfx_combat_shield_break
description: A crack runs round the glass bubble, its pressure lets go, pieces fly

name: sfx_combat_heal
description: A warm breath drawn in over a low stroked glass

name: sfx_combat_danger
description: The orb's glass strains -- a creak swelling under pressure -- and a fissure runs across it

name: sfx_combat_victory
description: Pressure let go into a vast dark room; something huge crumbles far off; pieces drift

name: sfx_combat_defeat
description: A dull heavy give, the breath going out, pieces drifting off into a small dark room

name: sfx_combat_special_cast
description: A latch releasing: a pawl clicks free and a heavy arm stops dead

name: sfx_basic_mane
description: Mane auto-attack: one throw lets two blades go together, one each side, flying off as a widening pair

name: sfx_basic_let
description: A heavy glowing rock thrown flat: a shove of air, then its rough flickering rush going away

name: sfx_basic_pip
description: Three darts flicked in one fan: dry releases inside 12 ms, three thin cuts receding left, centre and right

name: sfx_basic_horn
description: Horn tosses its head: a heavy swing of air, a thick slug shoved away, the head's weight stopping under it

name: sfx_basic_mask
description: A breath through a narrow tube and a thin needle tearing the air, receding

name: sfx_basic_wing
description: Two small glowing bolts leave together and draw apart: thin bright streaks receding over the ~0.24 s flight, a fizz behind each

name: sfx_basic_kin
description: A kin's charged line let go: a narrow sear at full at once, dying with the 0.28 s beam

name: sfx_basic_mystic
description: Three soft motes let go on one frame: a single hushed release, three narrow airs receding together, a breath of warmth under it

name: sfx_survival_wave_start
description: A wave forming beyond the rim: pressure leaning in, a low swell, a far clatter of many dark bodies

name: sfx_survival_wave_clear
description: The wave broken: the pressure let out, its dust settling, the low swell going

name: sfx_survival_boss_arrive
description: A boss arriving: space ruptured, a great obsidian mass driven in groaning, settling with a weight

name: sfx_survival_powerup_collect
description: The meter surging full: a hot rush filling the vessel to the brim, its dark glass core taking the charge

name: sfx_survival_powerup_choose
description: A power taken: the charge drawn in and a heavy glass stopper seated

name: sfx_survival_outbreak
description: An outbreak growing: flesh stretching, something wet bubbling up, spores puffed out at its anchors

name: sfx_survival_milestone
description: Wave 50 broken: a heavy settle, a long exhale into something vast, dust coming down

name: sfx_dungeon_interact
description: A touch on carved stone that gives a hair and catches

name: sfx_dungeon_gate_open
description: A catch lets go, a slab grinds clear shedding dust, and seats

name: sfx_dungeon_switch
description: A mechanism turned one notch: stone pivot, pin into detent, its glass lit under

name: sfx_dungeon_puzzle_solved
description: The room's mechanism travels and seats home; its leaded glass lights under it

name: sfx_dungeon_star_collect
description: A star drawn up on a breath and set into its stone socket, glass lit beneath

name: sfx_dungeon_secret_reveal
description: A stone gives way to one side and a leaded piece lights up behind it

name: sfx_dungeon_wall_break
description: Masonry cracks, falls in pieces, rubble scatters, dust hangs

name: sfx_dungeon_block_move
description: A stone block grinds one place along and settles

name: sfx_dungeon_hazard_trigger
description: A lurch of shifting stone and grit pouring down after it

name: sfx_dungeon_checkpoint
description: A breath in and something set down gently on stone, warm glass under

name: sfx_dungeon_relic_collect
description: Old weight pressed into stone; deep leaded glass lights slowly under it

name: sfx_dungeon_step_stone
description: A padded foot on dressed stone, a little grit under it

name: sfx_dungeon_step_water
description: A foot into shallow water: plunge, slosh, trapped bubbles, drops

name: sfx_creature_summon
description: A companion gathering out of its grains: a swirl in, easing as they land feet first, whole

name: sfx_capture_throw
description: A harvester chosen: a pinch of grains into glass

name: sfx_capture_attempt
description: Rings of motes close on the specimen, bite, and strain as it shoves

name: sfx_capture_success
description: The specimen turned to grains and drawn down, turning, into the harvester, sealed with a small glass

name: sfx_capture_escape
description: The field thrown apart with a breath of heat; the specimen shrugs it off

name: sfx_harvest_collect
description: A chamber collected: the flask drains, its essence venting up out of the surface

name: sfx_extraction_complete
description: Collect all: every finished chamber lets go at once

name: sfx_extraction_creature_reveal
description: Grains swirl home and settle with a soft weight; a low glass rings once

name: sfx_extraction_rare_reveal
description: A held, charged beat, then grains swirl home and settle into two glass bodies

name: sfx_element_fire
description: Ignition and crackle: a breath of gas catching into a fluttering flame

name: sfx_element_water
description: A splash, the bubble cloud it drives under, droplets and a swaying slosh

name: sfx_element_air
description: A gust that leans in, circles the field like a whirlwind and lifts away

name: sfx_element_earth
description: Stone grinding loose, grit pouring down, the heap taking its weight and one small bounce

name: sfx_element_lightning
description: An electric discharge: leader crackle into a snap, then arcing bursts that jump about the field

name: sfx_element_steam
description: A valve chuffs and vents a falling hiss that widens as it billows, droplets spitting

name: sfx_element_lava
description: A heavy viscous glorp, big slow bubbles bursting through it, a fine sizzle and a thick drip

name: sfx_element_poison
description: Wet acrid bubbling: blisters swelling and bursting, a sour fizz, a drip

name: sfx_element_ice
description: Frost crackling in, the sheet cracking and creaking under strain, one cold glassy tick

name: sfx_element_mud
description: A thick suck and squelch, then slow plops into the puddle

name: sfx_element_dust
description: A dry sandy whoosh: the wind takes it and sand streams downwind

name: sfx_element_crystal
description: Crisp fractures and one clear quartz body answering, its facets glittering

name: sfx_element_plant
description: Leaves shaking out and rustling as they sway, a woody creak of stems growing

name: sfx_element_spirit
description: A whispered breath rising and thinning, a glass stroked faintly under it

name: sfx_element_dark
description: An inhale: the room drawn in, its top closing, swirling faster until it is swallowed

name: sfx_element_light
description: A soft bright swell opening from the centre: warm air, flickering shimmer, a few motes

name: sfx_element_blood
description: A heartbeat heard as flow: two thick surges through a vessel and a viscous gurgle

name: amb_cosmic_space_loop
description: The open cosmos: a deep slow tide of air, a far hush, dust drifting past, something enormous turning far off

name: amb_dungeon_ruins_loop
description: Stone ruins: still dark air, a wandering draught, grit and pebbles far off

name: amb_dungeon_water_loop
description: Wet stone: a far trickle, slow lapping, drips into pools at no pace

name: amb_dungeon_fire_loop
description: Hot stone: a fire breathing in another chamber, embers cracking, heat ticks

name: amb_dungeon_arcane_loop
description: Arcane stone: unpitched low resonance in the walls, air moving in a large room

name: amb_lab_loop
description: The Harvest room: warm low air, a flask simmering faintly, the bench settling now and then

name: sfx_cosmic_matter_collect
description: A mote of matter drawn into the hold: a short soft intake and a pinch of grains settling

name: amb_cosmic_boost_loop
description: The booster held: turbulent combustion roar, flame flutter, crackle, exhaust hiss, the hull shaken under it

name: sfx_extraction_ceremony
description: Two parents' grains gather into one shell, settle as it cinches, and ring it open as it unravels

name: sfx_fusion_merge
description: Two specimens turn to grains, pour over the gap and circle the orb, then fall in and bloom

name: sfx_fusion_eruption
description: A hot knot shivers, erupts, and is gathered back into a cultivation whose sigil locks with a glint

name: sfx_fusion_calibrate
description: A wild fusion's catalyst spent: both turn to grains where they stand and glint while the verdict is out

name: sfx_fusion_pour
description: The verdict held: the standing pair pour together, circle and fall in to a bloom

name: sfx_fusion_recoil
description: The verdict failed: the grains run back up into the pair and they settle, whole

name: sfx_reward_flight
description: A reward thrown out of its card, drawn in faster and faster, and settled into its total

name: sfx_constellation_attune
description: Grains run down a constellation link for 1.05 s, and the obsidian stone seats and ignites as they land

name: sfx_altar_rite
description: The Mystic Altar's rite: offerings pour into the middle, are crushed into a shivering, heating knot, and it bursts into a spray of grains and embers

name: sfx_altar_awake
description: The Mystic awake: its grains settle and it takes a first breath, in and a long breath out

name: sfx_altar_seal
description: Sealed and departing: grains wind into a sphere, a glass stopper is turned home, and it drops away

name: sfx_altar_rift_tear
description: The Mystic Altar heart torn into the arcane rift: its grain disk spinning up over 3.4 s, tearing at the flash

name: sfx_ship_bolt
description: The ship's gun: a capacitor crack, the air the bolt shoves aside, the dark-glass hull knocked by the recoil

name: sfx_ship_missile
description: A missile: a clamp lets go on the hull, the motor catches and tears away, thinning

name: sfx_special_pip
description: A pip salvo: shafts sliding as the fan opens, a riffle of seven dry releases, keen cuts spreading wide and away

name: sfx_special_pip_seeker
description: Slow homing needles: a soft riffle, then low fluttering cuts that swing out and curl back in

name: sfx_special_pip_heavy
description: Three knapped stone heads let go: gritty flint knocks and thick low cuts of air

name: sfx_special_pip_ricochet
description: A dart point skidding off obsidian and cutting away the other way: dry, a few ms, under the hit

name: sfx_special_pip_void
description: Dark pip's black hole opening: air rushing in to a point, narrowing and darkening, grit falling in after it

name: sfx_special_mask
description: A sowing sweep and many soft set-downs across the field at once; the ground answers

name: sfx_special_mask_single
description: One aimed sweep and one weighty set-down, the floor giving under it

name: sfx_special_mask_feed
description: Fibres parting at the root and a thick trunk groaning as it swells

name: sfx_special_mask_wrap
description: Air circling round and five small stones knocking into their orbit

name: sfx_special_mask_spring_light
description: A bright incision tearing, then air drawn into the slit, cut off

name: sfx_special_mask_spring_crystal
description: A crystal cracks and breaks; three pieces land apart

name: sfx_special_mask_spring_fire
description: A fire ball bursts into a pool: a flaring whumpf, flame spreading, embers

name: sfx_special_mask_spring_water
description: A splash: the surface slapped open, bubbles, drops falling back

name: sfx_special_mask_spring_dark
description: A gulp that closes off, then a streak of air thrown out to one side

name: sfx_special_wing
description: The held beam, 2.1 s hold: a jet of pressure roaring out of the wing, a searing hiss, sparks where it lands thickening each tick; gone in a breath

name: sfx_special_wing_ring
description: Fire/Poison ring, 2.1 s: pressure laid out round the wing, a stream circling once per 1.85 s with the band dragging on the ground; fades over its last 0.45 s

name: sfx_special_wing_charge
description: Lightning: 3 s of air drawn into a growing storm orb, sparks and arcs quickening, then one tearing blast down the line and the air settling

name: sfx_special_mane
description: Mane catapult: a heavy body heaved off, its churning rush crawling away and darkening over ~2 s

name: sfx_special_mane_gale
description: Mane Air: a heavy gust thrown hard, buffeted, tearing away to one side in under a second

name: sfx_special_mane_volley
description: Mane Fire: one throw comes apart into a spray of small fast tears of air across the field

name: sfx_special_mane_scatter
description: Mane Lightning: a handful of small orbs flung out every way at once, light flicks all round

name: sfx_special_mane_stream
description: Mane Spirit: the throw, a ripple of edges in close file, a lighter body crawling away

name: sfx_special_mane_ward
description: Mane Light: a weight swung out and taken into orbit, one slow arc of air settling into a held turning

name: sfx_special_mane_orb_land
description: Mane Lightning orb seats and its shock field takes: a soft settle and a spreading crackle

name: sfx_special_mane_burst
description: Mane Mud ball bursts on its first hit: a thick wet splat and ten clods flung every way

name: sfx_special_mane_shatter
description: Mane Crystal prism blows on a boss: a crack runs, a dense mineral crunch under a blast, facets fly

name: sfx_special_mane_quake
description: Mane Earth slab sheds a chunk: a short stone crack, a dull damped body, grit

name: sfx_special_wing_long
description: The held beam, 2.7 s hold: a jet of pressure roaring out of the wing, a searing hiss, sparks where it lands thickening each tick; gone in a breath

name: sfx_special_wing_longest
description: The held beam, 3.4 s hold: a jet of pressure roaring out of the wing, a searing hiss, sparks where it lands thickening each tick; gone in a breath

name: sfx_special_wing_ring_long
description: Fire/Poison ring, 2.7 s: pressure laid out round the wing, a stream circling once per 1.85 s with the band dragging on the ground; fades over its last 0.45 s

name: sfx_special_wing_ring_longest
description: Fire/Poison ring, 3.4 s: pressure laid out round the wing, a stream circling once per 1.85 s with the band dragging on the ground; fades over its last 0.45 s

name: sfx_basic_let_deadfall
description: Deadfall: a small burning rock falling 0.52 s onto its mark, peaking at touchdown

name: sfx_special_let
description: A burning rock falling out of the sky for 0.52 s: far and dark, nearer, louder and wider until touchdown

name: sfx_special_let_earth
description: Earth's moon drop: a bigger rock falling 0.70 s from higher, its roar reaching lower

name: sfx_special_let_impact
description: A meteor landing: the ground takes the mass, the stone seats, pressure goes out, clods patter back down

name: sfx_special_let_impact_earth
description: The moon drop landing like a hammer: a deeper mass, more ground thrown, a tremor after

name: sfx_special_let_impact_airy
description: Air/Spirit/Light landing: the mass and the pressure front, no curtain of ground thrown

name: sfx_special_let_impact_barrage
description: One of Dark's follow-up meteors landing: a full landing with its tail cut short

name: sfx_special_let_impact_minor
description: A small mastery rock landing in its minor crater: a small mass, a short crush, a few clods

name: sfx_special_mystic
description: A Mystic opens its world: the seal scribed in one turn, the world gathering in from the screen's edges over 0.6 s into a large dark space that rings on

name: sfx_special_mystic_rise
description: A world that grows after the seal (Dark's maw, Plant's grove): the edges gather slower over a heavy material straining open for ~1 s

name: sfx_special_mystic_close
description: The caster gone, its world closes over 1.8 s: the edge air thins and darkens and the big room draws in to nothing

name: sfx_special_mystic_strike
description: Lightning world: static drawn in for 0.62 s, a tearing strike, thunder rolling off far away

name: sfx_special_mystic_quake
description: Earth world: stone grinding harder for 1.6 s, then the ground heaves and a front of rubble crosses the arena; grit settles

name: sfx_special_mystic_vent
description: Steam world: the arena exhales -- a vast hiss leaving the middle and billowing outward with the front, gone in ~1.2 s

name: sfx_special_mystic_rain
description: Lava world: a crack flares with a molten roar and spitting fire, and rocks rush down out of the sky

name: sfx_special_mystic_meteor
description: One molten rock landing: a dull heavy body, the crust crunching, spatter, the scorch hissing

name: sfx_special_mystic_dawn
description: Light world: the star breaks -- a warm rush rolling out with the bloom, then a lit, open space with two low bodies glowing under it

name: sfx_special_horn
description: A ram: the horn sets off and the rough air it shoves comes up fast, holds while it runs and lets go

name: sfx_special_horn_heavy
description: Lava/Earth ram: a slow deep set-off, a lower rougher shove and grit ground loose all the way

name: sfx_special_horn_circle
description: Water: the shove of air goes once round the listener in a second, near side bright, far side dark

name: sfx_special_horn_gather
description: Crystal: held 1.2 s, horn and sinew creaking tighter as the air turns round it, then the ram

name: sfx_special_horn_brace
description: Spirit: held 2.0 s, the strain building as the swarm turns in, then the ram

name: sfx_special_horn_void
description: Dark: five seconds straining against a growing pull, the air dragged past, reeled-in bodies knocking together, then a very fast ram

name: sfx_special_horn_barrier
description: Light: the horn plants itself, and inside the dome the air takes its hollow hush over a low stroked glass for five seconds, breathing, then thins

name: sfx_special_horn_slam
description: A ram landing: a dense dull blow, stone giving, a short skid, the shock and the debris thrown forward

name: sfx_special_horn_slam_heavy
description: Earth/Lava ram landing: lower and softer in the blow, bigger pieces thrown, the heap settling

name: sfx_special_horn_brew
description: Lightning horn holding 3 s: static crawling thicker, arcs jumping more often, the air tightening

name: sfx_special_horn_discharge
description: The brewed storm let go: crackle leaning in and spreading, pressure shoved out, sparks thinning away

name: sfx_basic_kin_charge
description: The last 0.6 s of a kin's charge: motes drawn into the glow, air narrowing; ends on the release

name: sfx_special_kin
description: A kin's blessing welling up: a warm swell rising, a few motes lifted away

name: sfx_special_kin_escort
description: Guards set turning round the kin, then peeling off to the ship (Light, Crystal)

name: sfx_special_kin_rain
description: A cloud gathering over the ship and rain starting on the hull (Water)

name: sfx_special_kin_updraft
description: A wind column taking hold round the ship, debris ticking up it (Air)

name: sfx_special_kin_garden
description: Damp loam opening as shoots push up, roots straining (Plant)

name: sfx_special_kin_wall
description: A stone rampart heaved up along an arc, sections seating, grit running off (Earth)

name: sfx_special_kin_bank
description: A bank of dust settling far off, fine grit left hanging in it (Dust)

name: sfx_special_kin_darts
description: A ring of wet spits round the field and the darts zipping away (Poison)

name: sfx_special_kin_charge
description: Frost forming finer and denser, ice under strain, air drawn in (Ice charge)

name: sfx_special_kin_ice_release
description: A frozen sheet giving, cold rushing out, fine ice thrown wide (Ice release)

name: sfx_special_kin_channel
description: A held charge: corona hiss with arcs crawling on it, pulsing (Lightning)

name: sfx_special_kin_plate
description: Basalt plates closing on each body, heat in the seams (Lava)

name: sfx_special_kin_boiler
description: An iron hatch seated, its wheel turned tight, pressure groaning inside (Steam)

name: sfx_special_kin_sling
description: Mud slung onto the hull with a wet slap, the trail starting (Mud)

name: sfx_special_kin_veil
description: A heavy cloth drawn over and everything hushed beneath it (Dark)

name: sfx_special_kin_pact
description: Sinew cords pulled taut round the field, the strain swelling once (Blood)

name: sfx_special_kin_wisp
description: A soul-flame kindled like a wick, fluttering as it swings round (Spirit)

name: sfx_special_kin_wisp_tier
description: The wisp's flame swelling larger and lower, a veil unfurling (Spirit tier-up)

name: sfx_special_kin_phoenix
description: Fire bursting back to life, embers thrown, reborn flames circling (Fire save)
